_about: EVERY rule value lives here (TEAM.md section 4). The engine reads this file; data/rules.json (what the page reads) is generated from it. Live rule since v2.0: pin_solo (Pinnacle moves alone). gap_guard is off (kept for its research rows). Probabilities 0-1, prices American integers, times Eastern.

Books: Hard Rock (DraftKings was a pick book 2026-11-03 6:49-9:46 AM, no picks made; now a second button only, pin_solo.link_books).

reads._spare_about: Matt, 2026-11-02 11:41 PM: bring the 11 AM read back from 2026-11-04 (no games 11-03). A read the month's allowance can't pay for still runs while the pool covers the planned reads (C, B, D) for every game left this month; then it pauses and the page says so until keys are added. close._about: Matt, 2026-11-12: a closing read for games that hold a pick, kept in data/odds_close/ for the closing-line score only. It never makes, changes or pulls a pick, and only spends credits the planned reads do not need.

extra._about: Matt, 2026-11-12 (research Run 11): extra price checks 75, 60 and 30 minutes before tip, so the last 90 minutes are checked every 15 minutes (90, 75, 60, 45, 30, 20). Hard Rock follows a Pinnacle move in 20-30 minutes; wider gaps miss most moves. Same rule, same bar: it only looks more often. About +12 credits a game. Trial: judged on picks a night and the closing-line score.

safety_pause.text: New picks are stopped: the Record is down 10 units or more.
safety_pause.sub: The team has to review before picks resume. Picks already shown are unaffected.

pin_solo._about: THE live rule since v2.0, widened v2.1 (Matt, 2026-10-28 11:52 AM): between two consecutive reads Pinnacle's de-vigged chance on Hard Rock's main line (same line on both reads at Hard Rock and Pinnacle) moves >= min_move toward a side while the median move of the other books (same line, both reads, >= others_min books) toward that side is < others_max (2 pts); bet that side at Hard Rock's price on the later read (flag_reads only, read <= max_age_min old). Discovery Oct 25-27: 31 bets 22-9 +9.74u (16 alone 11-5 + 15 with others 1-2 pts 11-4). v2.2 (Matt, 2026-10-28 6:10 PM): Hard Rock's price on that side must also be >= min_gap_vs_pin (2 pts of break-even, ~10 cents) better than Pinnacle's new posted price (Bane O2.5 threes: HR -140 vs Pinnacle -134). Replay at 2 pts: 13 bets 10-3 +5.87u. v2.3 (Matt, 2026-10-29 8:00 AM): the gap gate is REPLACED by min_ev_vs_pin 0.0: Hard Rock's price must be at or better than Pinnacle's FAIR price on that side (its new chance, Pinnacle's own margin removed; EV vs Pinnacle >= 0%). Research Run 7 discovery Oct 25-28: 16 bets 12-4 +7.12u vs the rest 28 bets 16-12 +1.33u. v2.5 (Matt, 2026-11-03 6:49 AM): the other books no longer matter (others_max/others_min null; only Pinnacle and the pick book must quote the same line); a pick can be at Hard Rock OR DraftKings: each book's price on the same line (quoted on both reads) must be at or better than Pinnacle's fair price; the pick shows every book that passes (link per book), headline and graded price = the best of them (ties: Hard Rock). v2.6 (Matt, 2026-11-03 9:46 AM): DraftKings is NOT a pick book (its own picks were flat in the replay); a Hard Rock pick also gets a DraftKings button (at DK's price) when DraftKings passes the same check on the same line (same line on both reads, price at or better than Pinnacle's fair). Graded at the Hard Rock price.

pin_judge.label: Pinnacle as the price judge
pin_judge.about: Behind the scenes (Matt, 2026-10-28): Hard Rock's main-line price is min_ev or better against Pinnacle's de-vigged chance on the same line. Research only: Backstage tab, never the Record or Discord. Discovery Oct 25-27 at +2%: 6 bets 5-1 +3.18u.

threes_judge.about: Lab (Matt, 2026-11-12; research Run 11 T1b): 3-pointers only, Hard Rock's main-line price 1%+ better than Pinnacle's de-vigged chance on the same line, no Pinnacle move needed. 18 nights before tracking: 17 bets 10-7 +6.15u, beat the close by 0.9%. Research only, never the Record or Discord.
